email.subject: Quick fix for Tidewater's website
email.body:
Hi Sofia,

I checked Tidewater Heating & Cooling's site and noticed two things likely costing you calls: there's no mobile-friendly layout, even though most people searching "hvac near me" do it on their phone, and there are no posted hours, so anyone with a furnace or AC emergency can't tell if you're open before they call a competitor instead.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
